drafts.rationale: The A-series specs all define a cap on how many times Orion may execute a job, including the initial execution and allowed retries.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: The B-series specs all prescribe the wait Orion must impose after a failed execution before starting a retry.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: The C-series specs all bound how long a single execution may run and require a timed-out execution to be treated as failed.
drafts.subject: Orion execution attempt

drafts.rationale: The D-series specs all state how Orion treats a further delivery of an already-active job so it is not executed twice.
drafts.subject: Orion job delivery

drafts.rationale: The E-series specs all require Orion to remember producer idempotency keys for a bounded time after first sighting.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency key

drafts.rationale: The F-series specs all define how long a worker lease lasts from delivery and that expiry without renewal or release makes the job available again.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: The G-series specs all describe when a worker may renew a lease and how a renewal extends the lease.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: The H-series specs all define what cancellation does to future attempts, an in-flight attempt, and later a repeated cancellation.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: The I-series specs all require an exhausted job to be moved to the dead-letter queue and not executed again unless resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: The J-series specs all trigger an operator escalation when a tenant accumulates three dead-letter events inside a one-hour window.
drafts.subject: Orion tenant dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: The K-series specs all limit first-in-first-out execution order to jobs in the same partition and deny any cross-partition order guarantee.
drafts.subject: Orion queue partition

drafts.rationale: The L-series specs all require job-state audit events to be kept for a bounded period after recording and allow deletion afterward.
drafts.subject: Orion audit events

drafts.predicate: duplicate delivery while job is active
drafts.rationale: EV-O-D01 and EV-O-D09 require ignoring further deliveries of an active job id without changing that job's state.

value.text: While a job with a given job id is active, any further delivery carrying the same job id must be ignored and must not change the state of the active job.

drafts.predicate: duplicate delivery while job is active
drafts.rationale: EV-O-D10 ignores a redelivery only when job id and idempotency key both match, and rejects a same job id with a different key as conflicting input.

value.text: While a job is active, a further delivery is ignored only when it carries both the same job id and the same idempotency key; a same job id with a different idempotency key must be rejected as conflicting input and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01 and EV-O-L10 require audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded, after which they may be deleted.
EV-O-C01 requires a thirty-second timeout; EV-O-C10 restates the same half-minute limit at which the execution must be stopped.
EV-O-J01 and EV-O-J10 require an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for one tenant within one hour of the first event.

value.text: Three dead-letter events for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of the three events, require an operator escalation.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G01 and EV-O-G10 allow a worker to renew its lease every thirty seconds while work on the job is progressing.
EV-O-G01 and EV-O-G10 require a renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

value.text: A renewal must extend the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E01 and EV-O-E10 require each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen, after which it may be forgotten.
EV-O-K01 and EV-O-K10 guarantee first-in-first-out order only within a partition and make no ordering promise across partitions.

value.text: FIFO execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering guarantee is made between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 cap a job at three executions in total, with the first execution counted in that cap.

value.text: A job must be executed at most three times in total, and the first execution counts as one of the three.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A03 introduces one initial execution plus up to three retries; EV-O-A06 and EV-O-A10 restate that one original execution may be followed by no more than three retries.

value.text: One original execution of a job may be followed by no more than three retry executions; after the third retry ends without success the job must not be executed again.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F01 and EV-O-F06 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from the moment the job is delivered to the worker.
EV-O-F07 changes the lease to ninety seconds from delivery; EV-O-F10 restates that ninety-second duration.
EV-O-I01 and EV-O-I10 require automatic dead-lettering after the last unsuccessful attempt and forbid further execution unless explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, Orion must automatically move the job to the dead-letter queue; a job there must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.predicate: effect on future and in-flight executions
drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01 and EV-O-H10 forbid starting further attempts after cancellation and require an in-flight attempt to run to its own end.

value.text: After a job is cancelled, no future execution attempt may be started; cancellation must not interrupt an already running attempt, which runs to its own completion, failure, or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H09 adds that a repeated cancellation leaves an already cancelled job unchanged; EV-O-H10 restates that rule.

value.text: If Orion receives a cancellation for a job that is already cancelled, the job must remain cancelled and the repeated cancellation must not otherwise change the job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B01, EV-O-B04, EV-O-B08, and EV-O-B10 require a wait of exactly five seconds before every retry, not varied by attempt number.
EV-O-B05 through EV-O-B07 require a two-second first retry wait that doubles on each later retry and is capped at thirty seconds.

value.text: Before the first retry the worker must wait two seconds from the failed execution; before each later retry the wait doubles the previous wait and must never exceed thirty seconds.
